description: social.md §4.9 author-tier moderation (L5): authorEffective (authorModeration, X ∈ E, until, CID binding, the table condition), authorGate per post tier, immunity of authorities, the precedence of the forum tier (keeps, hides, unlocks, locks, thread pins), author bans per thread, author locks with allowed, and the mod-log status of author-scope records. input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: the modfold projection fields listed (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section); V6 appears in modStates as Hidden(AuthorModerated). Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: author-hide-in-own-thread
vectors.note: alice (granted, so in E = S) author-hides carol's comment in her own thread (personal post; authorModPersonal = 0 ≤ K = 0): Hidden(AuthorModerated) (V6). Author-tier values act at rank 0 and never enter forum-tier resolution, so `resolved` has nothing for the comment and the record's spam = true is ignored (data-model.md §6.7)

vectors.name: author-hide-only-in-own-thread
vectors.note: the table condition author(root(c)) = X fails for a hide in someone else's thread: alice's hide of a comment under bob's post, and bob's and carol's hides under alice's post, are unauthorised and have no effect

vectors.name: author-gate-personal-0-frontpage-1-at-K-0
vectors.note: authorGate(X, p) ⇔ X ∈ A ∨ K[X] ≥ the gate of p's effective tier: authorModPersonal (0) for personal p1, authorModFrontpage (1) for frontpage p2 and curated p3. alice has K = 0 (no opinions), so the hide works exactly where the gate is 0

vectors.name: author-gate-personal-1-frontpage-0-at-K-0
vectors.note: authorGate(X, p) ⇔ X ∈ A ∨ K[X] ≥ the gate of p's effective tier: authorModPersonal (1) for personal p1, authorModFrontpage (0) for frontpage p2 and curated p3. alice has K = 0 (no opinions), so the hide works exactly where the gate is 0

vectors.name: author-gate-49-50-personal-and-frontpage
vectors.note: the karma/1 default gates: five seeds (four authorities and granted sam, all with K1 = KP = 0, so every vote has power 1 and no pair cap binds) upvote all 10 of alice's items (K = 50) and 49 of bob's 50 voter-item pairs (K = 49). alice's hide works under her personal post (K = 50 ≥ authorModPersonal 50) but not under her frontpage post (50 < authorModFrontpage 2000); bob's fails under his personal post (49 < 50)

vectors.name: author-tier-immunity-of-authorities
vectors.note: authorities are immune to author-tier hides, bans and locks: alice's hide of mike's comment and her ban of adam are unauthorised; her lock (allowed = []) leaves the comments of mike, adam and the owner, and her own comment, visible, and locks dave out; carol is author-banned

vectors.name: forum-keep-beats-author-hide
vectors.note: AuthorModerated(c) needs resolve(c, hidden) = Default: mona's keep of c1 (rank 1) beats alice's hide, which shows overridden (rank 1); mike's forum hide of c2 governs (Removed, rank 1); c3 is author-hidden. alice's ban of dave applies to c5 but not to c4, which adam kept (keepRank > 0)

vectors.name: forum-unlock-beats-author-lock
vectors.note: an author lock applies only if resolve(p, locked) = Default: mona's forum #lock{locked: false} on p1 (rank 1) governs, so carol's comment there stays visible and alice's lock shows overridden; on p2 alice's lock (allowed = []) locks carol out

vectors.name: forum-lock-governs-author-lock
vectors.note: a forum-tier lock resolves locked = true at rank 1, so alice's author lock (whose allowed list names carol's comment) is ignored and shows overridden: V7 hides carol's comment and also alice's own, because the post's author is exempt only from her own author lock

vectors.name: author-who-is-also-a-moderator
vectors.note: mona (moderator) wrote the post and issues both scopes; scope is part of the key, so her forum and author hides of c1 are two records. The forum hide governs c1 (Removed, rank 1; the author hide is overridden). Her author hide of c2 works under the default gates (50, 2000) because authorities bypass every gate. On mike's comment both fail: the forum hide by the rank rule (equal rank, not the subject's author) and the author hide by immunity

vectors.name: author-ban-only-in-own-threads-gated-per-thread
vectors.note: alice's author ban of carol hides carol's comments only in threads of posts p with author(p) = alice ∧ authorGate(alice, p): her personal post passes (gate 0), her frontpage post does not (gate 1 > K = 0), bob's thread is not hers; carol's own post is untouched (author bans act on comments)

vectors.name: author-thread-pins
vectors.note: alice pins comments in her thread (author scope, CID-bound): c1's pin is effective; mona's forum unpin of c2 (rank 1) governs, so alice's pin of c2 is overridden; erin edited c3 after the pin, so it is stale; carol's pin is unauthorised (not her thread). Pins do not change states; rank/rank.json shows their effect on comment order

vectors.name: author-moderation-disabled
vectors.note: policy.authorModeration = false: no author-scope record has an effect; the mod log shows them unauthorised

vectors.name: author-actor-must-be-in-E
vectors.note: authorEffective needs X ∈ E: alice is a participant (open mode) but neither a seed nor established, so her hide is unauthorised; bob is granted (a seed), so his works

vectors.name: author-until-and-cid-binding
vectors.note: until: a hide counts while µs(until) > now (now + 1 µs: effective; now: expired). carol's hide is both unauthorised (not her thread) and expired: authorisation is checked first. A positive author pin whose subjectCid is not the comment's current CID is stale

vectors.name: author-lock-with-allowed
vectors.note: alice's author lock of p keeps the comments in its allowed list (carol's c1; the entry naming a comment of q is outside p's thread and ignored), her own comment (author(c) ≠ X), the authority's, and the one mona kept (resolve(c, hidden) ≠ Default); dave's comment is locked out. Her #lock{locked: false} on q is effective and locks nothing

vectors.name: author-tier-needs-the-root-post
vectors.note: root(c) = records[c.root.uri] must exist for any author-tier effect on c: alice's first post is not in records and her second is invalid (PO3: its title is only U+2003 EM SPACE), which the model treats as missing (V1 excludes it; NOTES.md, Author tier). Her hides and her lock of the missing post are unauthorised and both comments stay visible

vectors.name: author-scope-outside-the-table
vectors.note: MA6: an author-scope keep, a hide of a post, #access{member}, a forum pin, #restrict, #tier and #tag are invalid (excluded from the fold and the mod log); an author-scope #lock of the forum uri is valid but reserved (MA9: reserved/unknown)
